scope: Native source-view and PHG rendering candidates for an identified NECA edition; no canon/human/runtime approval

entries.prompt:
Create version A, a faithful isolated rigid biomask of the existing NECA Ultimate Ahab2017 figure shown in these two official photos. The FIRST reference is the source camera: use the masked figure at the LEFT of its catalogue sheet, retaining its actual nearly frontal, slightly bowed/inclined view and projected proportions. The inset on the right is an UNMASKED head and is anatomical separation evidence only. The second photo supports the same edition's side contour, not a reason to invent a profile view. Do not substitute another Ahab edition or a new design.
Extract only the hard biomask: broad rounded silver-grey crown with its real raised border and THREE oblique forehead gouges; low aggressive brow; narrow dark eye lenses; actual circular cheek mechanisms and short side fittings; long curved silver cheek/muzzle edges around the LARGE OPEN U-SHAPED lower aperture. The teeth, mandibles and flesh visible through that aperture belong to the wearer and must be removed, leaving genuine alpha in the opening. No teeth, jaw, skull necklace, dreadlocks, straps, shoulders, cape, weapons or shoulder cannon may remain. Preserve only the attested exterior mask plates, existing edge irregularities and actual restrained weathered grey/silver paint. Do not add horns, rows of new vents, runes, glyphs, gold/copper paint or a closed chin. Do not invent the hidden mask back or interior. Keep the original width/height, short jaw edges, asymmetries and source view; no frontal symmetry redesign or elongated muzzle.
One complete source-view mask cutout only, centered with8–12percent empty margin on every side, no cropped tips. True transparent exterior and central aperture, no painted checkerboard, no floor, shadow plane, caption, logo or panel border. Render the photographed toy sculpt and its paint grain faithfully, rather than upgrading into a different movie/game sculpt. This is a source-bound licensed NECA edition study, not a certified original comic model.
entries.sourceEdition: NECA Ultimate Ahab2017; separate photographed edition/view, not automatic new canonical geometry.
limitations: Source-view extraction from a licensed figure, not an exact original comic mesh or2014 edition substitution.
Fine metal pitting, tiny grooves and small camera rectification are interpreted.
Organic teeth/mandibles inside lower opening are excluded; lower aperture is genuinely transparent.

entries.prompt:
Create version B by restaging ONLY the isolated Ultimate Ahab2017 biomask in reference1 into the consistent high-quality Predator: Hunting Grounds equipment presentation. References2 and3 are the official NECA Ultimate2017 photographs; reference1 fixes the camera, shape, proportions, aperture and feature positions. Preserve that same nearly frontal, slightly bowed source view, broad rounded crown border, exactly three diagonal forehead gouges, narrow dark eye lenses, circular cheek mechanisms, actual small side fittings and the short curved lower silver edges around the large open inverted-U aperture. The small metallic ridges at the INNER TOP of the U are genuine rigid mask detail confirmed by the photos: keep these grey ridges, but never add the wearer's separate beige teeth, jaw or mandibles behind them. Keep the central opening genuinely transparent. No skull necklace, flesh, dreadlocks, cape, shoulders, weapons or shoulder cannon. No invented horns, new vents, glyphs, hidden back/interior, symmetry redesign or elongated jaw. Do not substitute Ahab2014 or a different comic state.
Change only material/light presentation: restrained upper-left key and soft frontal fill, believable weathered cast/brushed steel/silver-grey, controlled fine grain instead of enlarged toy-paint pitting, readable existing medium-scale relief and source-specific edge wear. Preserve the source grey/silver palette and existing damage, without bronze/copper recoloring, new colored reflections, glowing eyes or polished chrome. Same sculpt, camera and silhouette as reference1, not a new design.
One whole isolated mask on real exterior alpha and a real empty-alpha U opening, centered with8–12percent transparent margin on every side, no clipped tips. No floor, shadow plane, caption, border, watermark or background. Preserve the projected width/height and all actual contour asymmetries of reference1; do not sharpen or lengthen the lower muzzle.

limitations: PHG material/light restaging of the photographed NECA Ultimate2017 mask, not a canonical comic certification.

Upper inner-U metallic ridges are supported by both photos; separate beige biological teeth are excluded and the aperture remains alpha-empty.
